row.evidence: HG Insights' (MadKudu's) Okta guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app for sign-in only and says 'To delete or update users, please do so in both Okta and HG Insights'; users are otherwise invited by hand or by emailing a CSV to support, and no SCIM is documented.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. MadKudu is now part of HG Insights: madkudu.com 301-redirects to hginsights.com and help.madkudu.com is the 'HG Insights Knowledge Base'; the MadKudu app (app.madkudu.com) and API live on as part of the HG RGI Platform. Pricing is quote-only (Starter, Growth, Enterprise plans structured around seats, credits and leads; no public prices). SAML SSO works through a custom Okta SAML app (no OIN listing); the plan that includes SSO is not stated. Users must be added in both Okta and HG, so no JIT or SCIM; bulk adds go through a CSV sent to support. The MadKudu API is a data API with no user endpoints. None by absence.

user_api.notes: The MadKudu API (madapi.madkudu.com, x-api-key) covers lookup, enrichment, search, sourcing and organisation info; its index lists no user, team or role endpoints.

okta.notes: No OIN app (okta.com/integrations/madkudu returns 404); HG documents a custom SAML 2.0 app, sign-in only.

fallbacks.notes: Users must be assigned in Okta and also invited in HG Insights (no JIT); CSV import is done by HG support from an emailed CSV. Sales users can auto-join Copilot from its login page.
